name: CEBB Sukhavati
aka: Centro de Estudos Budistas Bodisatva - Sukhavati

location.address: Av. Dom Pedro II, 6506 (Estrada Velha da Graciosa), Quatro Barras, PR, Brazil

tradition: Tibetan Buddhism (Nyingma lineage) as taught by Lama Padma Samten, rooted in an original Zen Buddhist foundation
technique: Shamatha and Dzogchen-based meditation, guided contemplation, and voluntary community work practice as part of daily monastic-style rhythm
teacherAccess: A resident local tutor supports practitioners during Vivência stays; periodic retreats are led in person or online by Lama Padma Samten and other CEBB teachers.
retreatOptions: Weekend introductory (Instrução) retreats; 7-21 night Vivência immersion stays with a tutor and voluntary community activities; closed retreats for continuing practitioners already under a tutor's guidance.
about: CEBB Sukhavati is a rural Buddhist retreat center of the Centro de Estudos Budistas Bodisatva (CEBB) network, located in Quatro Barras about 30 km from Curitiba, Paraná. It follows the same Nyingma-rooted, Zen-founded approach taught by Lama Padma Samten across CEBB's rural villages elsewhere in Brazil. The center offers introductory weekend retreats, longer 'Vivência' immersion stays of 7 to 21 nights in which guests join the community's daily rhythm of meditation, study, and voluntary work under a local tutor, and closed retreats for continuing practitioners. Guests stay in collective dormitory-style lodging and take part in preparing the community's shared vegetarian meals as part of the immersion.
schedule: Regular weekend retreats and Vivência immersion stays (7-21 nights, arranged individually) plus periodic teaching retreats through the year.
cost: Suggested voluntary contribution of R$70 per day, covering lodging, shared vegetarian meals, and program; the amount is adjustable and registration is not conditioned on payment.

pricePerDay.notes: R$70/day is the published suggested contribution for the Vivência immersion program, covering lodging, shared meals, and program; the figure is voluntary/adjustable, not a mandatory fee.

foodNotes: Vegetarian ingredients and kitchen facilities are provided; guests take turns preparing communal meals as part of the retreat's work practice.
workNotes: Guests join community tasks such as preparing shared vegetarian meals and general upkeep as part of the Vivência immersion.
